valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.pb_withheld_reason: Withheld: total equity for FY2025 is -1.031e+09 (negative), so a P/B over negative book value is not meaningful. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are H1 2026, an interim and not annualised.
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the P/E would stand on a FY2025 net profit of +117,889,421, but the same filing prints a LOSS per share (Shs 0.08 basic and diluted for FY2025, Shs 0.13 for FY2024), and the stored EPS of +0.08 reconciles with neither (405,255,320 shares x 0.08 = 32.4m against a stored profit of 117.9m). The profit row and the per-share row of the same statement contradict each other, so the earnings this P/E would divide by are not verified. A blank is honest; a positive multiple resting on an unresolved contradiction is not.
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings yield is the inverse of the P/E and stands on the same FY2025 net profit of +117,889,421 that contradicts the filing's own printed loss per share (Shs 0.08), so the earnings it divides by are not verified. A blank is honest; a yield resting on an unresolved contradiction is not.
